purpose: Teach: モットー/貸与/累計/問屋/立ち寄り/小売り/衣料/言明

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社のモットーを新人に伝えろ
lines.en: Tell the new hires about the company motto.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Quick breath between clauses. Authority without warmth — the instruction of someone who doesn't repeat himself. Hands off; expects competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社用パソコンの貸与手続を済ませました
lines.en: Yes. I've completed the computer issuance paperwork.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Steady pace, matter-of-fact delivery. Small emphasis on 'completed' — shows the task is done. No decoration, no apology.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 累計売上の推移をまとめろ
lines.en: Compile the sales trend report for me.
lines.style: Curt, expectant. Slight downward inflection — not a question. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. Clean attack on the opening word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。問屋との取引条件を更新中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently updating the wholesale terms.
lines.style: Steady, informative. Light emphasis on 'updating' to show active progress. Respectful but not obsequious. The report of someone managing tasks in real time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様のお店に立ち寄りで挨拶しろ
lines.en: Visit our key clients' stores and offer your greetings in person.
lines.style: Brief, purposeful. Slight pause after 'stores' — the instruction sits, expecting acknowledgement. Cool, businesslike tone. No negotiation in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。小売り部門の売上が伸びております
lines.en: Yes. Retail division sales are increasing.
lines.style: Calm assertion. Light lift on 'increasing' — brings positive news without fanfare. Respectful cadence, but confident. The tone of someone delivering good work to his boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、衣料品の新ラインを開発しろ
lines.en: We're developing a new clothing line.
lines.style: Declarative, forward-facing. Slight emphasis on 'new' — it matters. Cool authority. The voice of someone making a strategic call, not requesting approval.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新方針を社内に言明いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll communicate the new direction to the staff.
lines.style: Affirming close. Steady, professional finality. Small emphasis on 'communicate' — shows he understands the scope. Respectful but not deferential. The last word lands with clarity.
